newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Natural to merge Ohio units.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Natural to merge Ohio units.

text.p: Consolidated Natural Gas Co said Thursday it would merge its two natural gas subsidiaries in Ohio, The East Ohio Gas Co and West Ohio Gas Co.
After the merger, West Ohio Gas will operate as a division of East Ohio Gas, and West Ohio's customers should see rates reduced by 11 percent annually, the company said.
The merger, which is expected to take effect by January, should lower Consolidated's costs and improve efficiency, the company said.
Cleveland-based East Ohio Gas serves 1.1 million customers in eastern Ohio, and West Ohio Gas serves 62,000 customers in west-central Ohio.
